hypotheses: Normalize the pullback equation by r+z and cancel target-dependent terms, reducing branch field multiplications.
Cache binary coordinates during charged elimination to reduce repeated conversions without changing field-operation accounting.
budget: Cooperative all-phase deadline; retain overruns, incomplete enumerations, errors and timeouts. No hard memory or time bound.
frozen_targets: All 12 exact targets from coefficient_pullback/results/raw.jsonl, paired again on the current host. Original evidence remains immutable.
holdouts: Freeze 12 fresh targets before any candidate measurement, excluding all prior solver_02 through solver_09 and coefficient_pullback targets. Do not tune on them within this round.
correctness: Exact per-branch coefficient sets versus previous pullback on all 43 five-bit affine targets, then complete solution sets versus independent pair oracle. Check every measured solution and every completed enumeration. Independently audit every full-DLP oracle call, including empty answers.
diagnostic_gate: At least 10 percent fewer field multiplications in aggregate complete equal-output enumeration on each frozen/fresh eleven-bit corpus for normalized versus old pullback; no loss of correctness. Coordinate-cache field counts must exactly match normalized counts on complete enumerations.
classification: Engineering candidate pending calibrated normalized total cost. No exponent or end-to-end speedup claim from this experiment.
boundary: O(2^(2d)) conditioned branches, O(d^2) field additions and O(d) multiplications for each restricted elimination. Uniform affine support yield <= min(1,8*C(B/2,3)/(#E-1)); unchanged. No applicable calibrated full-cost floor available.
benchmark_adapter: The accepted WDSat corpus uses a=1 and another protocol. Continue the matched a=0 S3/S4 suite under the parent contract; retain WDSat unchanged.

full_dlp.pipeline: Unmodified cofactor-correct coefficient_pullback/e2e.py pipeline with only the decomposition callable substituted; all setup, failures, modular matrix and final verification charged. Cold runs first; no warm amortization.

cost_unit: Separate field API add/mul/square and scalar modular add/mul/invert vectors. Control/conversion cost only in wall time; no measured common-operation conversion. Runtime is descriptive; one repetition provides no confidence-interval speedup claim.
